DARESR

Distributionally Adaptive Regression Estimator under Series Expansion.

Overview

Least squares regression can be very inefficient when the error distribution is far from Gaussian, for example with heavy tails or outliers. The distributionally adaptive regression estimator (DARE) of Dai (2025) estimates the conditional mean E[Y∣X=x0]E[Y \mid X = x_0] as a weighted combination of conditional quantiles at the levels k/(K+1)k/(K+1), k=1,…,Kk = 1, \dots, K. The weights adapt to the unknown error distribution, and the number of quantiles KK is chosen by cross-validation. Under regularity conditions DARE attains the asymptotic variance of the infeasible likelihood-based estimator while keeping the convergence rate of conventional estimators.

DARESR implements the series (B-spline) version of DARE. Each covariate is expanded in a B-spline basis, conditional quantiles are fitted by quantile regression (quantreg), and the quantiles are combined with weights from the inverse of their estimated asymptotic covariance matrix. The estimate comes with a standard error and a 95% confidence interval.

Documentation: https://shengtao-dai.github.io/DARESR/

Installation 

# From r-universe (no compiler needed)
install.packages("DARESR", repos = c("https://shengtao-dai.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

# Or the development version from GitHub
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("shengtao-dai/DARESR")

Example 

library(DARESR)

# Simulated data with heavy-tailed (t, 3 df) errors; the true m(0, 0) is 0.5
set.seed(123)
n <- 500
X <- cbind(rnorm(n), rnorm(n))
Y <- as.numeric(0.5 + X %*% c(1, -1) + rt(n, df = 3))

res <- series_eq_estimate(Y, X, x0 = c(0, 0), p = 4, degree = 4,
                          K_grid = c(1, 3), L = 2)
unlist(res)
#>       m_hat_series_eq     cov_hat_series_eq m_hat_series_eq_lower
#>            0.35851451            0.14271055            0.07880183
#> m_hat_series_eq_upper
#>            0.63822719

Main functions

Function Purpose
series_eq_estimate() DARE estimate of E[Y | X = x0], with standard error and 95% CI

Related packages

  • DARELL: DARE with local linear regression
  • DARERF: DARE with random forests
  • DARESR: DARE with series (B-spline) expansion (this package)

Citation

If you use DARESR in your work, please cite:

Dai, S. (2025). Distributionally Adaptive Regression Estimators. Working paper. https://ssrn.com/abstract=5683602

@unpublished{dai2025dare,
  title  = {Distributionally Adaptive Regression Estimators},
  author = {Dai, Shengtao},
  year   = {2025},
  note   = {Working paper, SSRN 5683602},
  url    = {https://ssrn.com/abstract=5683602}
}

You can also run citation("DARESR") in R.
